nodes.label: iCloud SMS 2FA Login Flow (background code worker)
nodes.rationale: auth login triggers the SMS then spawns a background worker polling ~/.icloud/code.txt, returning once phase=awaiting_code (~5s) so the agent can prompt the user; auth verify writes the code the worker consumes. Apple invalidates the trusted session roughly every 30 days, after which login+verify are simply rerun.

nodes.label: iCloud Credential Resolution Order (config.json → Keeper → env)
nodes.rationale: Tries ~/.icloud/credentials.json first, then a Keeper record whose title contains 'Apple ID' or 'iCloud' (no hardcoded record UID), then ICLOUD_APPLE_ID for the email only.
